placeholders.$comment: Values behind each {placeholder}, proposed by open-meteo-integrator and confirmed by Wren. All are taken over the best window.
placeholders.{temp}: mean over the best window (feels-like for air, sea surface temperature for water), whole degrees F
placeholders.{mph}: mean wind speed over the best window, whole mph
placeholders.{ft}: maximum offshore wave height inside the best window, one decimal only if under 10
placeholders.{pct}: maximum rain chance inside the best window, integer %
placeholders.{in}: total precipitation over the best window, two decimals
placeholders.{time}: start of the first hour concerned, like 2 pm, local time
placeholders.{hours}: number of usable beach hours, integer
